label: Timed fact drill
description: Rapid-fire single-digit sums under a short response-time budget. Testing skill.add_to_fluent specifically, not skill.add_to -- the time pressure is the point, distinguishing automatised retrieval from a correctly-executed but slower strategy.
prompt: Rapid-fire single-digit sums, e.g. '6 + 3 = ?', answer expected within roughly 3 seconds.
source: Carpenter, Fennema, Franke, Levi & Empson, Children's Mathematics: Cognitively Guided Instruction (2nd ed., 2014)
